description: Lists the team's exercise groups (circuits and sets) with rounds and exercise counts. Use when the user asks which circuits or exercise groups exist, or wants to find one by name. Not for single exercises (use list_team_exercises). Returns group IDs, names, kind, rounds and exercise count, with has_more for paging.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

search_text.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_exercise_groups
title: List exercise groups
